source.label: Synthetic assessment fixture

metricDefinitions.label: Users
metricDefinitions.definition: One assigned authenticated user per row. Converted means at least one booked loan within seven days of assignment. Offers shown counts distinct offer_viewed records; shown users have at least one. Spend is additive allocated touch spend in demo currency units. One pre-assignment campaign touch per user.

metricDefinitions.label: Guardrail metrics
metricDefinitions.definition: Explicit event-based numerators; denominators: leads for lead-to-offer, shown users for acceptance/rejection/requests, booked loans for mean disbursement, all form users for form-error rate, email users for unsubscribe, requesting users for price-reduction success. Price reduction means lower APR, not lower total borrowing cost.

metricDefinitions.label: Experiment segments
metricDefinitions.definition: New/Returning user type, baseline credit bracket and requested term_months are pre-treatment. Campaign and user segment cuts are exploratory, unadjusted. Primary risk difference uses all assigned users and Newcombe 95% bounds; Fisher exact p is two-sided.

metricDefinitions.label: Marketing scope
metricDefinitions.definition: Allocated acquisition-cohort spend, views and clicks; one click per acquired session plus synthetic attributed impressions. Not whole-campaign reach. CPL = spend/leads; CPB = spend/bookings; conversion = booked leads/leads; amount minus spend is disbursed principal less ads, not revenue, profit or ROI.

metricDefinitions.label: MCP assisted
metricDefinitions.definition: At least one MCP tool call by the prediction cutoff. Association only; not randomized assistance.

caveats: Synthetic dataset. Logistic regression is trained locally; GenAI evaluation labels remain simulated.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce
evidenceFlow.detail: Run python build_data.py (seed 4271). Read raw JSONL, deduplicate events, quarantine invalid JSON, decode metadata using Polars, resolve session identities, join facts at declared keys, then materialize Parquet and this snapshot.

metricDefinitions.definition: One trace per row. Evaluation fields are simulated rubric labels, not live judge scores. Tool-call counts come from nested logs; intent is a keyword baseline.

caveats: Synthetic dataset. Logistic regression is trained locally; GenAI evaluation labels remain simulated.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce
evidenceFlow.detail: Run python build_data.py (seed 4271). Read raw JSONL, deduplicate events, quarantine invalid JSON, decode metadata using Polars, resolve session identities, join facts at declared keys, then materialize Parquet and this snapshot.

source.label: Synthetic assessment fixture

metricDefinitions.label: Turns
metricDefinitions.definition: One trace/turn. Context and tool results are inspectable synthetic logs.

caveats: Synthetic dataset. Logistic regression is trained locally; GenAI evaluation labels remain simulated.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce
evidenceFlow.detail: Run python build_data.py (seed 4271). Read raw JSONL, deduplicate events, quarantine invalid JSON, decode metadata using Polars, resolve session identities, join facts at declared keys, then materialize Parquet and this snapshot.

source.label: Trained logistic regression on synthetic lending data

metricDefinitions.label: Prediction point
metricDefinitions.definition: 200 seconds after session start; activity and original quotes available by that cutoff only. Excludes acceptance, booking, price changes, unsubscribe, escalation outcomes and evaluation labels.

metricDefinitions.label: Per-lead contributions
metricDefinitions.definition: Grouped coefficient × transformed-feature terms in log-odds. Intercept plus all terms reconstructs the probability through sigmoid. Missing-rate indicator is grouped with rate. These are not SHAP or causal effects.

metricDefinitions.label: Evaluation
metricDefinitions.definition: Chronological Train Oct1–5, Validation Oct13–14, Test Oct22–23; intervening leads purged to keep seven-day outcome windows mature before the next split. Select C on validation AUC; fixed 0.5 threshold. Test never used for fitting or model selection.

caveats: Synthetic dataset. Logistic regression is trained locally; GenAI evaluation labels remain simulated.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce
evidenceFlow.detail: Run build_data.py then train_booking.py. Train-only preprocessing and logistic fit; validation-only C selection; score held-out test; verify contribution additivity.

rows.detail: 600 sessions map to exactly one authenticated user.
No missing or multiplied booking records.
Every displayed offer references an existing offer.
Seven replayed events removed by event_id.
One assignment per user before offer exposure; 50:50 Bernoulli allocation.
One row per assigned user; all seven-day outcome windows mature by November 1.
Grouped trained coefficients reconstruct every lead probability.
All input events precede the 200-second prediction point; every booking follows it.
Seven-day label windows close before the next split; no shared users; train-only preprocessing.

source.label: Synthetic assessment fixture

metricDefinitions.label: Checks
metricDefinitions.definition: Executed assertions from the local deterministic pipeline; these are not production SLA checks.

caveats: Synthetic dataset. Logistic regression is trained locally; GenAI evaluation labels remain simulated.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce
evidenceFlow.detail: Run python build_data.py (seed 4271). Read raw JSONL, deduplicate events, quarantine invalid JSON, decode metadata using Polars, resolve session identities, join facts at declared keys, then materialize Parquet and this snapshot.

source.label: Executed model evaluation

metricDefinitions.label: ROC-AUC
metricDefinitions.definition: Ranking discrimination on positive-class probability scores; 0.5 is chance.

metricDefinitions.label: Precision and recall
metricDefinitions.definition: At fixed threshold 0.5: precision TP/(TP+FP), recall TP/(TP+FN). Undefined denominators display unavailable for filtered subsets.

caveats: Small synthetic test cohort; not real-world performance evidence.
